title: Name & Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
rule_description: Complete postal address with PIN code & legal identity of manufacturer, packer, or importer.

title: Net Quantity in Standard SI Units
rule_description: Must use SI metric units (kg, g, L, ml, m, N). Non-standard symbols such as 'gm', 'gms', 'ltr', 'kilo' are strictly illegal.

title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & Tax Declaration
rule_description: Must declare '₹ XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)'. Dual MRP stickers or higher rate overwriting constitutes a compounding offence.

title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
rule_description: Mandatory declaration of price per unit (per g, per kg, per ml, per L, or per number) to allow direct consumer value comparison.

title: Numeral & Letter Font Height on PDP Area
rule_description: Minimum font height determined by Principal Display Panel area (1.0mm for <50cm², 2.0mm for 50-200cm², 2.5mm for 200-1000cm², 4.0mm for >1000cm²).
